submittedArguments.prompt: Production game icon sheet, 24 distinct symbols in exactly SIX columns by FOUR rows, transparent 1536x1024 canvas. Each 256x256 cell has ONE complete distinct icon centered, 155-175px subject, wide clean transparent gutters, absolutely no cut-off elements, grid frames, labels or text. Match attached style references only: refined hand-painted Daoist Q jade, warm ivory and fine golden accents, gently rounded outlines, beautifully painted texture and shading, readable at tiny size, not photographic and not plastic CGI. ROW 1 left to right: (1) eye, jade almond eye and ivory pupil; (2) eye-off, same eye crossed with a clear gold slash; (3) file-image, ivory page showing a jade mountain pictogram; (4) file-text, ivory page with three simple jade lines (no alphabet); (5) file, blank ivory page with folded gold corner; (6) fill, tipped jade pigment pail spilling a little jade paint. ROW 2: (7) flip, paired ivory triangles with a vertical gold mirror axis; (8) folder-parent, jade folder with clear gold up arrow; (9) grid, nine ivory square tiles in a 3x3 arrangement with gold separators; (10) hammer, chunky jade-handled gold carpenter hammer; (11) home, small ivory house with jade curved Taoist roof; (12) host, small ivory server chest with jade roof and three gold linking nodes. ROW 3: (13) info, jade circle with an ivory lowercase i clearly rendered as icon; (14) item, polished faceted golden ore chunk; (15) line, one strong diagonal jade stroke with gold endpoint dots; (16) link, two interlocking warm-gold chain loops; (17) liquid-consume, jade water droplet with a small downward gold arrow; (18) liquid, simple plump jade water droplet with ivory gleam. ROW 4: (19) load-image, ivory landscape page with gold incoming arrow; (20) load, jade archive box with a gold upward/outward arrow; (21) loading, ring of eight small jade/gold beads with a clear gap; (22) lock-open, open golden padlock with jade body; (23) lock, shut golden padlock with jade body; (24) map, folded ivory map with winding jade road and a small gold location pin. Keep icon identity, cell order, equal optical scale, soft natural hand painted details. TRUE transparent background; no background color or cast drop shadows.
